children: Comcast’s Xfinity today announced that more than 1,000 new homes and businesses in Beaufort and Edisto now have access to multi-gigabit Internet from America’s smartest and most reliable, converged network. The completed network expansions extend Xfinity’s fiber-powered network across South Carolina’s Lowcountry, reaching Beaufort County and the Charleston County portion of Edisto.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:

“Bringing Xfinity’s network to more residents and businesses in Beaufort and Edisto unlocks far more than faster Internet connection,” said Keir Murray, Vice President of Local Government & Community Affairs, South Carolina. “Customers can now access an integrated suite of Xfinity products – from multi-gig Internet and Mobile to entertainment and Xfinity Shield – that work together to keep them connected, entertained and protected. Local businesses can also tap into Comcast Business solutions designed to strengthen operations, protect their networks and support growth.”

Reaching underserved communities often requires collaboration and a shared commitment to closing connectivity gaps. Through public-private partnerships supported by federal American Rescue Plan Act funding, Comcast was able to bring its network farther into Beaufort and Edisto – reaching homes and businesses in areas where the cost and complexity of construction can make broadband expansion challenging. The Beaufort County expansion was supported through the Capital Projects Fund, while the Edisto expansion built upon a previously funded State and Local Fiscal Recovery Funds project.
Residents can visit
and businesses should visit

to see if their address is eligible for service. The expansions in Beaufort and Edisto are part of Comcast’s continued investment in South Carolina, which also includes a network expansion in Hampton County.

“Reliable broadband is critical infrastructure for a strong and competitive local economy,” said Megan Morris, President and CEO of the Beaufort Regional Chamber of Commerce. “Expanding access to high-speed Internet gives businesses the tools they need to compete, supports a strong workforce, and helps attract new investment. These improvements strengthen Beaufort County’s business community and position our region for continued economic growth.”

“Expanding reliable Internet access is a critical investment in Edisto’s future,” said Charleston County Council Chairman Joe Boykin. “This new infrastructure will help residents stay connected to work, education, healthcare, and other essential resources, while giving local businesses the tools they need to serve their customers and support Edisto’s tourism-based economy.”
Xfinity Brings Full Suite of Residential Services to Beaufort and Edisto

Comcast is bringing its full suite of residential Xfinity services to Beaufort and Edisto, including high-speed Internet, streaming, mobile, voice, and home security – delivering reliable, connected experiences for today’s consumers at home or on the go.
Xfinity Internet
: Speed, Reliability, and Coverage.
With multi-gig speeds, 99.9% reliability, and powerful WiFi that reaches every corner of the home, Xfinity powers streaming, gaming, and video calls – simply and seamlessly.
Xfinity Home Solutions
: Protection Beyond Connectivity.

Powered by Comcast’s advanced network and Xfinity Gateway technology, WiFi Shield is built into our connectivity experience and leverages AI capabilities to transform WiFi into a protection platform for the home. Shield Select offers additional self-monitored security features, while Xfinity Home Security provides the ultimate peace of mind with professionally monitored protection.
Xfinity Mobile
: Most Reliable Network. Fraction of the Cost.

Xfinity Mobile delivers reliable, lightning‑fast speeds – up to 1 Gig – at home and on the go. And now, new customers can get one line free for a full year when they sign up for a qualifying Xfinity Internet plan.
Xfinity TV
: All Entertainment. One Powerful Platform.

Xfinity brings together live TV, streaming, sports, and on-demand content in one easy-to-use experience. With the award-winning Xfinity Voice Remote, finding a show, channel, or game is fast, easy, and frustration-free.
Comcast Business: Technology Solutions for Businesses of Any Size

Comcast Business delivers powerful, secure, and always-on connectivity tailored to meet the needs of businesses – whether small startups or growing enterprises. With fast, reliable Internet and advanced networking solutions like SD-WAN, cloud connectivity, and unified communications, Comcast Business helps organizations stay connected, protected, and ready to scale.

For businesses on the move, Comcast Business Mobile offers fast, dependable 5G, flexible data plans, and access to over 23 million WiFi hotspots nationwide. With features like 4K streaming, advanced spam call blocking, and twice-a-year phone upgrades, it’s a mobile solution designed to keep teams productive – wherever business takes them.
What It Means for Lowcountry Communities
Comcast's ongoing investment in the Lowcountry will help ensure more residents and businesses have access to the connectivity needed to participate in today's increasingly digital economy.

The expansions will also support the region’s tourism-based economy, helping local restaurants, retailers, vacation rental operators and other small businesses connect with customers, manage their operations and grow.
Supporting digital opportunity is also a key part of Comcast’s commitment to the communities it serves.

Through Internet Essentials, Comcast helps eligible households connect to affordable, high-speed Internet service, access laptops and develop digital skills. The program is designed to help more people access educational, economic and healthcare opportunities that increasingly depend on reliable connectivity.
About Comcast Corporation

Comcast Corporation (Nasdaq: CMCSA) is a global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, our businesses reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. We deliver world-class broadband, wireless, and video through Xfinity, Comcast Business, and Sky; produce, distribute, and stream leading entertainment, sports, and news through brands including NBC, Telemundo, Universal, Peacock, and Sky; and bring incredible theme parks and attractions to life through Universal Destinations & Experiences.
